EXEMPT_INCOME_UNIQUE.message: "{{label}}" cannot be selected more than one time under Exempt Income.
EXEMPT_INCOME_UNIQUE.remediation: Merge the duplicate "{{label}}" rows into a single row.
EXEMPT_INCOME_UNIQUE.source: "{{label}}" drop-down cannot be selected more than one time under Exempt Income.

OTH_SRC_UNIQUE.message: "{{label}}" cannot be selected more than one time under Income from Other Sources.
OTH_SRC_UNIQUE.remediation: Merge the duplicate "{{label}}" rows into a single row.
OTH_SRC_UNIQUE.source: "{{label}}" drop-down cannot be selected more than one time under Income from other sources

DONEE_MODE_MANDATORY.message: In Schedule 80G, table {{blockName}}, either 'Donation in cash' or 'Donation in other mode' must be entered; the total deduction column cannot be entered without it.
DONEE_MODE_MANDATORY.remediation: Enter the donation amount for every row in table {{blockName}}, or remove the empty rows.
DONEE_MODE_MANDATORY.source: In Schedule 80G in table {{blockName}} donation in cash or donation in other mode is to be entered mandatory without which total deduction column should not be entered

DONEE_TOTAL_EQUALS_MODES.message: In Schedule 80G, table {{blockName}}, the total donation must equal the sum of 'Donation in cash' and 'Donation in other mode'.
DONEE_TOTAL_EQUALS_MODES.remediation: Re-open Schedule 80G so the row totals are recomputed.
DONEE_TOTAL_EQUALS_MODES.source: Total Donation should be equal to sum of "Donation in cash" AND "Donation in other mode" in table (80G) {{blockName}}

NEW_REGIME_ZERO.message: Under the new tax regime the deduction claimed u/s {{sectionLabel}} must not be more than 0. {{claimed}} has been claimed.
NEW_REGIME_ZERO.remediation: Set the {{sectionLabel}} claim to 0, or opt out of the new tax regime.
NEW_REGIME_ZERO.source: If New Tax Regime is selected then In Schedule VIA, deduction claimed u/s {{sectionLabel}} should not be more than "0"

ELIGIBLE_LE_ENTERED.message: The eligible amount of deduction claimed u/s {{sectionLabel}} ({{eligible}}) should not be more than the user-enterable amount ({{entered}}).
ELIGIBLE_LE_ENTERED.remediation: Re-open the Total Deductions screen so the eligible amount is recomputed.
ELIGIBLE_LE_ENTERED.source: Eligible amount of deduction claimed u/s {{sectionLabel}} should not be more than user enterable amount

VIA_MATCHES_SCHEDULE.message: The deduction u/s {{sectionLabel}} claimed under Chapter VI-A ({{claimed}}) must be the same as the "{{totalLabel}}" per {{scheduleName}} ({{schedule}}).
VIA_MATCHES_SCHEDULE.remediation: Adjust the {{scheduleName}} rows so that they total {{claimed}}, or change the {{sectionLabel}} claim to {{schedule}}.
VIA_MATCHES_SCHEDULE.source: Deduction u/s {{sectionLabel}} claimed under chapter VIA should be same as the "{{totalLabel}}" as per {{scheduleName}}

SCHEDULE_ROWS_SUM.message: In {{scheduleName}} the sum of the individual rows for "{{column}}" ({{expected}}) must match the "Total of Payments" as per {{scheduleName}} ({{total}}).
SCHEDULE_ROWS_SUM.remediation: Re-open {{scheduleName}} so the total is recomputed.
SCHEDULE_ROWS_SUM.source: In {{scheduleName}} the sum of individual rows for "{{column}}" shall match with the "Total of Payments" as per the {{scheduleName}}

SCHED_80D_INSURER_TOTAL.message: In Schedule 80D the breakup of the individual rows for 'amount of premium paid' ({{rowsTotal}}) must match the health insurance premium entered at Sl. No. {{block}} ({{header}}).
SCHED_80D_INSURER_TOTAL.remediation: Adjust the insurer rows at Sl. No. {{block}} so that they total {{header}}.
SCHED_80D_INSURER_TOTAL.source: In schedule 80D, breakup of individual rows for "amount of premium paid" shall match with the Health insurance premium entered by the user under "Health insurance" at sl.no.{{block}}

SCHED_80D_INSURER_DETAILS.message: Details such as the name of the insurer and the policy number are required in Schedule 80D to claim a deduction for health insurance at Sl. No. {{block}}(i).
SCHED_80D_INSURER_DETAILS.remediation: Enter the insurer name and policy number for every row at Sl. No. {{block}}(i).
SCHED_80D_INSURER_DETAILS.source: Details such as name of the Insurer, Policy number are required to be provided in schedule 80D to claim deduction for health insurance at sl. No. {{block}} (i)
